verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a pricing guide and a self-serve marketplace and search page where prices for GPU offers are visible and queryable via `vastai search offers`, with no sales contact involved. Community posts cite median per-hour rates such as $0.38/hr for an RTX 3090 and $0.79/hr for an A100, which suggests prices are publicly observable. However, hosts set their own prices, so there is no single published per-GPU-hour rate per GPU type, and a community user complained it takes many clicks to find even an approximate price, on a pricing page that loads slowly. Missing for 10: a fixed published per-GPU-hour rate for every GPU type, explicit confirmation the pricing page is viewable without login, and an easily scannable price table.
